BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Survivor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the harsh wasteland, learning to fight for survival from an early age. [PAWN_pronoun] witnessed the dangers of uncontrolled technology and lawless raiders, which shaped [PAWN_possessive] worldview. When the Brotherhood recruited [PAWN_objective], [PAWN_pronoun] found purpose in their disciplined military structure.

BackstoryDef.title: Head Paladin
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] became the Brotherhood's Head Paladin, commanding all military operations. [PAWN_pronoun] is known for [PAWN_possessive] strict interpretation of the Codex and unwavering dedication to the Brotherhood's isolationist policies. [PAWN_pronoun] believes outsiders are dangerous and that the Brotherhood must remain pure and separate from the wasteland's chaos.

BackstoryDef.title: Scholar's Apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] showed exceptional intellectual aptitude from a young age. [PAWN_pronoun] was fascinated by pre-war technology and spent countless hours in the Brotherhood's archives, reading everything [PAWN_pronoun] could find. The elder scribes recognized [PAWN_possessive] potential and provided advanced training in scientific methods and technological analysis.

BackstoryDef.title: Head Scribe
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] became the Brotherhood's Head Scribe, leading all research and documentation efforts. [PAWN_pronoun] conducted groundbreaking research on super mutants and wrote detailed reports on [PAWN_possessive] findings. [PAWN_possessive] work is meticulous and [PAWN_pronoun] believes knowledge and understanding are the Brotherhood's greatest weapons.

BackstoryDef.title: Library Helper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up surrounded by books and holotapes in the Brotherhood's extensive library. [PAWN_pronoun] helped organize and catalog materials from an early age, developing a deep appreciation for the preservation of knowledge. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read multiple pre-war languages and became skilled at deciphering damaged texts.

BackstoryDef.title: Entrance Greeter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the Brotherhood's official greeter, posted at the entrance to screen every wastelander who comes asking to join. [PAWN_possessive] easygoing manner puts visitors at ease right up until [PAWN_pronoun] turns them away toward the Glow on the High Elder's orders. [PAWN_pronoun] studies under Vree in whatever hours are left, turning a love of books into the beginnings of a real scribe's career.

BackstoryDef.title: Military Brat
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a Brotherhood military family and raised with strict discipline. [PAWN_pronoun] trained in combat from childhood, learning to handle weapons and wear power armor. [PAWN_pronoun] excelled in physical training and showed natural leadership abilities that impressed [PAWN_possessive] instructors.

BackstoryDef.title: Brotherhood Paladin
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] earned the rank of Paladin through dedication and combat prowess. [PAWN_pronoun] serves as a guard within Lost Hills and participates in field operations when needed. [PAWN_pronoun] is respected by [PAWN_possessive] peers for [PAWN_possessive] reliability and commitment to the Brotherhood's mission.

BackstoryDef.title: Brotherhood Recruit
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was recruited into the Brotherhood as a young child after showing promise. [PAWN_pronoun] underwent basic training and education, learning the Brotherhood's values and principles. [PAWN_pronoun] worked hard to prove [PAWN_pronoun] belonged, eager to advance through the ranks and serve the organization.

BackstoryDef.title: Quartermaster
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the storeroom out of an office wedged between the training chamber and the shelves themselves, and holds the line on procedure for every last systolic motivator that passes through it. [PAWN_pronoun] can't authorize an issuance without Talus, Rhombus, or the High Elder signing off, but nothing leaves inventory unlogged on [PAWN_possessive] watch.

BackstoryDef.title: Security Detail
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up learning the importance of vigilance and protection. [PAWN_pronoun] was trained to identify threats and respond quickly to danger. [PAWN_possessive] instructors noted [PAWN_possessive] sharp reflexes and ability to remain calm under pressure.

BackstoryDef.title: Entrance Paladin
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] earned the rank of Paladin and was assigned to guard the entrance to Lost Hills alongside other defenders. [PAWN_pronoun] has proven [PAWN_objective]self in combat and is trusted to be the first line of defense against any threats to the Brotherhood's primary base.

BackstoryDef.title: West Coast Wanderer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth traveling the West Coast with [PAWN_possessive] Brotherhood family. [PAWN_pronoun] learned about the various settlements and factions, developing an understanding of the wasteland beyond Lost Hills. This experience gave [PAWN_objective] a broader perspective than many Brotherhood members.

BackstoryDef.title: Brotherhood Paladin
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] earned the rank of Paladin through dedication and combat prowess, and now rotates between guard duty at Lost Hills and escort runs to the San Francisco outpost. [PAWN_possessive] instructors expect a Senior Paladin's bars within a few years if [PAWN_pronoun] keeps up the pace.

BackstoryDef.title: Technical Prodigy
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] showed exceptional technical aptitude from a young age. [PAWN_pronoun] could disassemble and repair complex devices with ease, impressing the Brotherhood's scribes, though it was steady hands and a calm bedside manner that eventually pointed [PAWN_objective] toward medicine instead of the workshops.

BackstoryDef.title: Chief Physician
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] serves as Lost Hills' chief physician, the Scribe every Paladin and Initiate alike ends up in front of sooner or later. [PAWN_pronoun] treats radiation sickness, gunshot wounds, and power armor injuries with equal patience, and keeps the bunker's aging medical stock running long past when it should have failed.

BackstoryDef.title: Maxson Bloodline
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into the Brotherhood's founding bloodline, grandson of the man who led the survivors out of Mariposa. From childhood [PAWN_pronoun] was drilled harder than anyone else at Lost Hills - nobody was going to say the name Maxson got him anywhere he hadn't earned.

BackstoryDef.title: High Elder
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] rose to Head Paladin on pure merit before the Council convinced [PAWN_objective] to take the High Elder's seat - the third of [PAWN_possessive] bloodline to hold it. [PAWN_pronoun] moderates the Council of Elders, casts the tiebreaking vote, and answers for every decision the Western Chapter makes.

BackstoryDef.title: Sparring Partner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was the Aspirant every instructor paired with the slow learners, patient enough not to humiliate them and stubborn enough to make them improve anyway. [PAWN_pronoun] never resented the assignment.

BackstoryDef.title: Combat Instructor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] made Knight and stayed in the training chamber by choice, drilling the next class of Aspirants under Senior Paladin Talus's watch. [PAWN_pronoun] would rather build ten competent soldiers than chase glory as one.

BackstoryDef.title: Late Bloomer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was an unremarkable Aspirant who took longer than most to clear the fork, but nobody who trained alongside [PAWN_objective] ever doubted [PAWN_possessive] nerve under pressure.

BackstoryDef.title: Patrol Knight
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] pulls patrol rotations around the Lost Hills perimeter, one of the Chapter's steady hands rather than its stars. [PAWN_pronoun] has never once missed a shift.

BackstoryDef.title: Scrapper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] got into more sparring-ring fights than any Aspirant on record, most of them unofficial. [PAWN_possessive] instructors eventually gave up trying to stop it and started betting on the outcomes instead.

BackstoryDef.title: Patrol Knight
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] made Knight on raw aggression as much as skill, and still takes every excuse to volunteer for the rougher assignments. [PAWN_pronoun] gets along better with a rifle than with paperwork.

BackstoryDef.title: Newest Face
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the youngest Initiate at Lost Hills, still getting used to the weight of the Codex's expectations. [PAWN_pronoun] follows Cabbot around every chance [PAWN_pronoun] gets, hoping some of the older Initiate's ease with the work will rub off.

BackstoryDef.title: Entrance Initiate
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] stands the entrance rotation alongside Cabbot, screening wastelanders and reciting the same rehearsed lines about the Brotherhood's mission. [PAWN_pronoun] hasn't decided yet whether [PAWN_pronoun] wants the sword or the quill.

BackstoryDef.title: Second Generation
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised on stories of the chapter's defeat at HELIOS One, taught that caution was the price of survival in a wasteland that had already broken the Brotherhood once. [PAWN_pronoun] took that lesson more seriously than most.

BackstoryDef.title: Elder
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] leads the Mojave Chapter from Hidden Valley, and put the bunker on lockdown years ago, certain the NCR was still hunting Brotherhood survivors. The chapter's isolation has cost them standing and resources ever since, and not everyone under [PAWN_possessive] command still agrees with the call.

BackstoryDef.title: Impatient Recruit
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] never had much patience for waiting things out. Even as a young Knight, [PAWN_pronoun] argued that the chapter's caution looked a lot like decline dressed up as strategy.

BackstoryDef.title: Head Paladin
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] commands the Mojave Chapter's Paladins and Knights, and has grown convinced that Elder McNamara's lockdown is bleeding the Brotherhood dry. [PAWN_pronoun] is searching the Codex for whatever [PAWN_pronoun] needs to force a change in leadership, by the book if possible.

BackstoryDef.title: Survivor of HELIOS
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was among the Paladins who made it out of the disaster at HELIOS One, and has never stopped treating every entrance and approach like it could be the next ambush.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of Security
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] commands security for the Hidden Valley bunker, personally guarding the entrance and running the patrols McNamara still permits outside. [PAWN_possessive] vigilance is the only reason the lockdown hasn't cost the chapter more than it already has.

BackstoryDef.title: Bunker-Born
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to two Brotherhood soldiers inside Hidden Valley itself and has never known another home. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up taking machines apart just to see how the bunker kept itself running.

BackstoryDef.title: Maintenance Chief
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] heads maintenance and manufacturing out of the bunker workshop, repairing weapons and armor for every Knight and Paladin in the chapter. [PAWN_pronoun] recently flagged the bunker's failing air filtration to Elder McNamara before it became a crisis - typical of [PAWN_possessive] work catching problems early.

BackstoryDef.title: Reluctant Scholar
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] tested into the Scribe track on raw aptitude, not enthusiasm, and it showed. [PAWN_pronoun] always did just enough to pass, never more.

BackstoryDef.title: Figurehead Head Scribe
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] holds the title of Head Scribe but does little to earn it, leaving the research, cataloging, and tech processing to Senior Scribe Schuler while [PAWN_pronoun] tends [PAWN_possessive] own projects. Nobody has managed to force the issue yet.

BackstoryDef.title: Range Regular
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent more hours on the shooting range than in the classroom, and could field-strip a service rifle before [PAWN_pronoun] could properly recite the Codex.

BackstoryDef.title: Quartermaster
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] staffs the armory and shooting range on the bunker's first floor, issuing and maintaining the chapter's weapons with the same discipline the Brotherhood expects of everything else. [PAWN_pronoun] knows the condition of every rifle in Hidden Valley from memory.

BackstoryDef.title: Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] took to weapon and armor repair early, trading favors for spare parts long before [PAWN_pronoun] ever wore power armor of [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: Roving Repairman
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] rotates through the Brotherhood's Mojave safehouses every few days, repairing gear for caps and keeping half-broken equipment in the field. [PAWN_pronoun] takes the destruction of any Brotherhood post personally - especially Hidden Valley itself.

BackstoryDef.title: Overachiever
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] finished every assignment early and asked for more, a habit that made [PAWN_objective] indispensable long before [PAWN_pronoun] earned any real rank.

BackstoryDef.title: Senior Scribe
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] does the work Head Scribe Taggart's title implies he does - research, cataloging, tech processing - and has stopped expecting credit for it. [PAWN_possessive] competence is the only reason the archive still functions at all.

BackstoryDef.title: Terminal Prodigy
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] took to pre-War computer systems faster than anyone [PAWN_possessive] instructors had trained, coaxing dead terminals back to life for fun.

BackstoryDef.title: Archivist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the data archives near the Elder's chambers running, and has spent weeks fighting a pre-War computer virus that surfaced after a patrol brought back an infected holotape. [PAWN_pronoun] can spot the virus jumping between terminals before most people notice anything's wrong.
